environment.build: Native development profile with opt-level 3 and debug information disabled, nightly rustc 1.100; frozen source-matched executables; automatic SSAA and full native quality
environment.contention: Active production training shared the CPU and GPU with explicit operator approval. One release renderer ran at a time with two-CPU affinity, a 10 GiB task RSS cap and free-memory floors. Two short capture repetitions are a shared-workstation screen, not isolated hardware throughput or long-run memory qualification
environment.hardware: Intel Core i9-12900K (24 logical CPUs), NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation (96 GiB VRAM), Linux Vulkan; release subprocesses pinned to logical CPUs 0 and 2

summary.timing_policy: stream_* uses complete wall time including validation, JSONL telemetry and drops while prefetched work advances; legacy scenes_per_second uses only capture spans and may overestimate delivery throughput. Preparation wall stages partition a task lifetime, overlap across rooms, and are not additive with capture wall time. update_phase_seconds classifies event-loop call time by the blocker observed before the call, not CPU/GPU execution. Render diagnostics can overlap and arrive late; not a per-scene GPU accounting partition. No PNG/dataset encoding unless save_samples; GPU utilization measured separately
